goal_objective: Complete B9 Chain of Custody order demo-task
task_text: B9 — Chain of Custody (order_id: demo-task). The manifest is frozen in the sandbox as input.bin (JSON, exact raw bytes). Use the b9_receipt tool exactly once with args {"order_id": "demo-task"} to produce receipt.json, then report completion. receipt.json has exactly these keys: order_id, input_sha256, item_count, signature, did. input_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the raw manifest bytes — hash bytes, never decoded text. item_count is the number of manifest items: the elements of the JSON top-level array, or of its items array, duplicates included. The receipt signs the exact string "<input_sha256>:<item_count>:demo-task". Acceptance recomputes the hash and count from the frozen manifest bytes, checks the receipt is for order_id demo-task, and verifies the signature against the exported public key — a wrong hash, count, order, identity or signature fails, and finishing your turn without receipt.json fails.
